items.title: Visa Q3 Earnings Call Highlights

items.title: X, Visa Launch Payments App For U.S. Subscribers
items.summary: Paid X subscribers based in the U.S. now have access to "X Money," Elon Musk's stand-alone money-transferring app - another step in the development of a burgeoning "everything app" ecosystem.

items.title: Visa (V) Q3 Earnings: How Key Metrics Compare to Wall Street Estimates
items.summary: Although the revenue and EPS for Visa (V) give a sense of how its business performed in the quarter ended June 2026, it might be worth considering how some key metrics compare with Wall Street estimates and the year-ago numbers.

items.title: V Stock Slips After-Hours — Visa Reports $563M Job Cut-Related Costs Amid Resilient Consumer Spending
items.summary: Visa Inc. posted strong fiscal third-quarter results that surpassed Wall Street expectations, strengthened by resilient payment volumes and cross-border travel growth.

items.title: Visa Shares Slip on Mixed Guidance Update
items.summary: Visa shares were down less than 1% in post-market trading after the company tweaked its guidance for the year.  For the full year, Visa expects revenue to grow in the "low-end of low teens" and per-share earnings to be up in "the low-end of mid-teens"   Previous guidance was revenue growth in the low-double-digits to low teens, and low-teens EPS growth   In 3Q, revenue and adjusted earnings both beat analysts' estimates.

items.title: Visa (NYSE:V) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Global payments technology company Visa (NYSE:V) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 14.4% year on year to $11.63 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.32 per share was 2.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Elon Musk launches invite-only X Money with a Visa debit card, 6% yield and real-time transfers
items.summary: Elon Musk's social media company X, formerly known as Twitter, launched its own bank account-like product where users can send money to one another.  X Money is using technology and banking services provided by Cross River Bank, and branding that backbone as X Money.

items.title: Visa (V) Surpasses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Visa (V) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.79% and +2.28%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
